title: pH Effect on Ligand Binding to an Enzyme Active Site
authors: Kushal Singh; Aswathy N. Muttathukattil; Prashant Chandra Singh; Govardhan Reddy
one_liner_zh: 该文用计算机模拟研究pH对胍离子与溶菌酶活性位点结合的影响，属广义蛋白-配体结合而非TF-DNA互作，但结合自由能面与马尔可夫态模型方法可迁移至TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Understanding the mechanism of ligands binding to their protein targets and the influence of various factors governing the binding thermodynamics is essential for rational drug design. The solution pH is one of the critical factors that can influence ligand binding to a protein cavity, especially in enzymes whose function is sensitive to the pH. Using computer simulations, we studied the pH effect on the binding of a guanidinium ion (Gdm + ) to the active site of hen-egg white lysozyme (HEWL). HEWL serves as a model system for enzymes with two acidic residues in the active site and ligands with Gdm + moieties, which can bind to the active sites of such enzymes and are present in several approved drugs treating various disorders. The computed free energy surface (FES) shows that Gdm + binds to the HEWL active site using two dominant binding pathways populating multiple intermediates. We show that the residues close to the active site that can anchor the ligand could play a critical role in ligand binding. Using a Markov state model, we quantified the lifetimes and kinetic pathways connecting the different states in the FES. The protonation and deprotonation of the acidic residues in the active site in response to the pH change strongly influence the Gdm + binding. There is a sharp jump in the ligand-binding rate constant when the pH approaches the largest p K a of the acidic residue present in the active site. The simulations reveal that, at most, three Gdm + can bind at the active site, with the Gdm + bound in the cavity of the active site acting as a scaffold for the other two Gdm + ions binding. This result implies the possibility of designing single large molecules containing multiple Gdm + moieties that can have high binding affinities to inhibit the function of enzymes with two acidic residues in their active site.
abstract_zh: 理解配体与其蛋白靶标结合的机制，以及影响结合热力学的各种因素，对于理性药物设计至关重要。溶液pH值是影响配体结合到蛋白空腔的关键因素之一，尤其是在功能对pH敏感酶中。通过计算机模拟，我们研究了pH对胍离子（Gdm+）结合至鸡蛋白溶菌酶（HEWL）活性位点的影响。HEWL作为具有活性位点中两个酸性残基和含Gdm+部分配体的酶模型系统，这些配体可结合至此类酶的活性位点，并存在于多种治疗各种疾病的已批准药物中。计算得到的自由能表面（FES）显示，Gdm+通过两条主要结合途径结合至HEWL活性位点，并占据多个中间态。我们表明，活性位点附近能锚定配体的残基可能在配体结合中发挥关键作用。利用马尔可夫状态模型，我们量化了FES中不同状态之间的寿命和动力学途径。活性位点中酸性残基响应pH变化的质子化和去质子化强烈影响Gdm+结合。当pH接近活性位点中酸性残基的最大pKa时，配体结合速率常数出现急剧跃升。模拟揭示，活性位点最多可结合三个Gdm+，其中结合在活性位点空腔中的Gdm+作为另外两个Gdm+离子结合的支架。这一结果暗示了设计含有多个Gdm+部分的单一大型分子的可能性，这些分子可具有高结合亲和力，以抑制活性位点含两个酸性残基酶的功能。
